## CredentialService.createProposal() method

Create a [ProposeCredentialMessage](./core.proposecredentialmessage.md) not bound to an existing credential exchange. To create a proposal as response to an existing credential exchange, use .

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
createProposal(connectionRecord: ConnectionRecord, config?: CredentialProposeOptions): Promise<CredentialProtocolMsgReturnType<ProposeCredentialMessage>>;
```
